description: Use the earlier modal equivalence for both epistemic and modal accessibility on the same four worlds and atom-invariant content family. Import its S5 properties and Boolean/nonconstant atom checks, prove the biconditional by content invariance, and compose admittedKnown. This jointly witnesses the three collapse assumptions with a true and a false value of an admitted nonconstant atom. It establishes nonvacuity of the formal background, not actual human knowledge or philosophical premise truth.
